title: chat-server and chat-types AGENTS.md cite spec paths outside references/ subdirectory; mail-server uses references/ — undocumented intentional path drift
description:
**Divergence** — spec-reference path style in AGENTS.md "Source Material" / "Specs" sections:
- crate-jmap-mail-server/AGENTS.md L50-L51 — both files in `~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec/references/`
- crate-jmap-chat-server/AGENTS.md L52-L57 — 5 `draft-atwood-jmap-chat-*` paths NOT in references/ (`~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec/draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md`), 1 `references/rfc8620.txt`
- crate-jmap-chat-types/AGENTS.md L65-L70 — same non-references/ paths for the 5 draft-atwood files

**Background**: the chat draft sources live in the top level of `~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec/`, not in `references/`. This is intentional (Mark authors the chat draft; `references/` holds upstream specs). The drift is correct — but it's undocumented.

**Maintainer cost**: a contributor without context might "fix" the chat-server path by moving the draft-atwood files into `references/` to "match the others", or by editing the AGENTS.md paths to match the canonical `references/` form.

**Fix**: add a one-sentence note to chat-server and chat-types AGENTS.md explaining: "draft-atwood-* paths intentionally live in the top level of jmap-chat-spec/ rather than references/, because this workspace authors that draft. references/ contains only upstream specs." Pure doc sweep.
